findings: Non-blocking: worktree vitest and Turbopack build failed on a known filesystem-junction artifact; the test suite was validated in the main tree, which does not contain these edits. The worktree `tsc --noEmit` and `--webpack` build both ran clean against the actual edits, and the changed files carry no dedicated behavioral tests, so the main-tree run would not have exercised the new behavior regardless. Runtime proofs (badge network panel, before/after file diff) remain the author's noted manual checks.

Non-blocking: the facet cache is invalidated only by the four comp-sync functions (fullSync, incrementalSync, resyncCompetitions, purgeExcludedCompetitions). No other writer to comp_fixtures sport/season/competition columns exists today (confirmed), but a future direct writer that bypasses these would serve stale facets.
